layout_dets.text: ABSTRACT

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Automatic crack detection from images of various scenes is a useful and challenging task in practice.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we propose a deep hierarchical convolutional neural network (CNN), called as DeepCrack,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to predict pixel-wise crack segmentation in an end-to-end method. DeepCrack consists of the extended

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fully Convolutional Networks (FCN) and the Deeply-Supervised Nets (DSN). During the training, the elab-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: orately designed model learns and aggregates multi-scale and multi-level features from the low convo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lutional layers to the high-level convolutional layers, which is different from the standard approaches of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: only using the last convolutional layer. DSN provides integrated direct supervision for features of each

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: convolutional stage. We apply both guided filtering and Conditional Random Fields (CRFs) methods to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: refine the final prediction results. A benchmark dataset consisting of 537 images with manual annotation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: maps are built to verify the effectiveness of our proposed method. Our method achieved state-of-the-art

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performances on the proposed dataset (mean I/U of 85.9, best F-score of 86.5, and 0.1 s per image).

layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Crack presents important information for the safety and dura-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bility of the man-made buildings. Hence, it is of great significance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to detect and analyze cracks for the maintenance of these build-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ings. In practice, the demand for automatic crack detection has in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: creased rapidly every year. A variety of traditional computer vision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods of crack detection from images have been proposed in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the past decades. In general, these methods can be classified into

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two categories: local-feature-based and global-feature-based meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods [1]. The former methods exploit the local features, such as in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tensity, gradient, local variance, and local texture anisotropy. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: later methods track and extracts crack curves in an overall view

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through dynamic programming to optimize target functions based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on certain criteria.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Since visually salient cracks are related to a lots of visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: patterns, it is difficult to design a universal method to deal with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cracks in various scenes. In other words, precisely detecting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: crack from natural images involves visual perception of various

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: “levels" [2,3]. However, both the mentioned two kinds of crack

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detection methods can not satisfy this requirement so that they

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: usually suffer a series of problems in practice. Recently, the su-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pervised deep learning methods, such as Convolutional Neural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Networks (CNNs), have achieved state-of-the-art performances in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: many high-level computer vision tasks, such as image recogni-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion [4], object detection [5–7], and semantic segmentation [8–12].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: These are powerful visual models that yield hierarchical features,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which is an ideal method to aggregate multiple “levels".

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the conventional approaches, the main problem in crack

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detection is the way to deal with noises introduced by stains,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spots, uneven illumination, blurring, and multiple scenes. Some

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods make an assumption that there is a clear distinction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: between noises and cracks, such as Iterative Clipping Method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (ICM) [13] which assumed that the intensities along cracks were

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: usually darker than those of its surroundings. Li et al. [14] pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sented a Neighboring Difference Histogram Method (NDHM) to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segment a crack image with a globally optimized threshold. How-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ever, the above assumption suffer issues when there are many

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dark spots and shadows in the test image. To improve the cor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rectness and completeness of crack detection, the wavelet trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: forms based methods [15,16] were proposed to raise up the crack

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: regions. However, they may not handle well the cracks with high

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvatures or bad continuities because of the anisotropic charac-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: teristics of wavelets. The “FoSA" approach [1] was proposed to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extend the NDHM with a stronger anti-noise capability and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: “CrackTree" method [17] was designed to remove the pavement

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shadows. These methods showed outstanding precision and recall

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rates, but they are too complex and time-consuming. Some meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods took both brightness and connectivity into consideration by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: measuring the image texture anisotropy, such as Conditional Tex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture Anisotropy (CTA) [18] and Free-Form Anisotropy (FFA) [19],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which showed good results on crack segmentation but were sensi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive to the edges which may enhance the noises sometimes. Then,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: saliency-based methods [20] were proposed to suppress noises. Hu

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. [21] used the Local Binary Pattern (LBP) method to ana-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lyze the basic local features to get good crack segmentation re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sults, but the parameters need to be adjusted for each image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Zhang et al. [22] proposed using the Black Top-Hat (BTH) transfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mation and the threshold segmentation method to detect cracks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from the concrete tunnel surface images but their method may

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encounter problems in uneven illumination images. More recently,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Zhang et al. [23] established a Region of Aggregation (ROA) method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to take multi-cues (cracks' spatial distribution, intensities, and geo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: metric features) into account and a Region of Belief (ROB) concept

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for crack region growing. However, such method was only designed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for thin cracks in 2–5 pixels wide.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Shortcomings of these traditional crack detections are obvious:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: each method was specifically designed for a specific database or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scene. Once the dataset or scene are changed, the crack detec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tors tend to suffer failure. For example, the FoSA, CrackTree, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: FFA methods can work well for thin cracks but fail to deal with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: wide cracks. The detector sometimes works, but sometimes fails,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which means that the extracted features are not generalized well.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The CNNs show powerful abilities that yield abundant hierarchical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features, which can make breakthroughs in such applications.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Up till now, there are some attempts of applying CNNs on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: object segmentation. The first strategy utilizes separated mecha-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nisms for feature extraction and image segmentation, in which it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: treats the CNNs as an assistant tool of the traditional computer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vision methods. Some representative examples like [24,25] ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plied the CNNs to extract meaningful features, used superpixels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to represent the structural pattern of the image, and then ob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tained the final labeling by aggregation of the classifier predic-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion. However, if there are errors in the initial superpixels, it may

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lead to poor predictions. The second strategy directly learns a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nonlinear model from the images and ground truth label maps.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Chen et al. [8,26] used a Conditional Random Field (CRF) to re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine the low-resolution segmentation results obtained from a CNN,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which means that they employed the CRF as a post-processing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: step (separated from the CNN training). Fully Convolutional Net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: works (FCN) [9] learns to upsample its feature maps – the outputs

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the convolutional layers – to achieve pixel-wise segmentation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: but can not produce very accurate labeling results. FCN showed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that different stages of the convolutional layers obtained diverse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: meaningful features, for example, low layers kept more structure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information, while the top layers obtained more abstract features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for object recognition. Therefore, coarse feature maps of the top

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: layers are not enough to obtain the refined segmentation results.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To overcome it, Zheng et al. [10] developed an end-to-end net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work which jointly learned the parameters of the CNN and CRF

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in a unified architecture termed CRF-RNN. The predictive perfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mance of FCN was improved further by CRF-RNN and fine-tuning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it on large datasets [27]. The fact that joint training helps was also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: presented in other recent studies [28,29]. Meanwhile, the decon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: volutional network [30] and its semi-supervised variant decoupled

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network [31] achieved better performances than FCN although at

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the cost of a more complex training. SegNet [12] proposed an idea

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the encoder-decoder architecture, which discards the fully con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nected layers and shows the benefit of reducing the number of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parameters significantly. Multi-scale deep architectures were also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: developed, which came into two main directions: (1) inputting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images at several scales into the networks [11,29]; (2) combining

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: feature maps from different layers of a deep architecture [32-34]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Their collective ideas were to learn multi-scale features, in which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: both local and global features will be kept.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: With the development of deep learning, a few methods that ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plied CNNs to achieve crack detection has appeared sequentially.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Some methods like [35-37] treated CNNs as a classifier to predict

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a label for each local patch, which was still far from pixel-wise

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation. In addition, both the mentioned traditional methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and CNNs-based methods have not published an open crack de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tection dataset, so the performances of these methods are some-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: times difficult to make a comparison. As shown in Fig. 1, we ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plore the meaningful features of each level layer in the following

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: way: (1) predicting crack segmentation results with feature maps

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of each convolutional stage, termed as side output; (2) concatenat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing all side outputs to produce a final fused result; (3) supervis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing both side outputs and fused results by Deeply-Supervised Nets

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (DSN) [38], which forms an integrated direct supervision; (4) re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fining the final fused result by applying Guided Filtering (GF) [39].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The parallel architecture like HED [3] was applied to crack de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tection and achieved the state-of-the-art performance. DeepCrack

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: takes full use of the advanced methods to achieve a deep end-to-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: end and pixel-wise crack segmentation architecture, which is the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: core topic of this paper. In addition, we built an open benchmark

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to evaluate the crack detection systems, in which multi-scale and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-scene cracks are manually annotated.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In summary, our proposed crack segmentation method has the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: following contributions:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. We developed an automatic crack segmentation method based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on CNNs. It learns hierarchical features of cracks in multiple

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scenes and scales effectively. Then, both CRFs and GF methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are applied to refine the predictions of CNNs.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. We explored the learning stage of CNN by using specially de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: signed loss function to alleviate the imbalanced data distribu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion, in which the negative pixels are far more than the positive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ones. To make the training effective, we apply DSN to facilitate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the feature learning of each convolutional stage.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. We established a public benchmark dataset with cracks in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-scale and multi-scene to evaluate the crack detection sys-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tems. All of the crack images in our dataset are manually an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: notated. To our knowledge, this is the first open work in such

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: field.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4. We established complete metrics to evaluate crack detec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion systems, including semantic segmentation evaluations,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Precision-Recall curve, and Receiver Operating Characteristic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (ROC) curve.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Proposed method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1. Model architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We formulate crack segmentation as a binary image labeling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: problem, where “0” and “1” refer to “non-crack” and “crack”, re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spectively. Such application is a task that requires both high-level

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features and low-level cues [40]. Our architecture, as showed in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig. 1, aggregates hierarchical features acquired from multiple lay-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ers. We use the 13 convolutional layers which correspond to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: first 13 convolutional layers in the VGG-16 net [41] designed for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: object classification. The fully connected layers and fifth pooling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: layer are discarded due to the following reasons: (1) we expect

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the meaningful side-output with different scales, and a layer af-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ter the fifth pooling yields a too small output plane (the interpo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lated prediction feature map is too fuzzy to generate a refined re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sult); (2) the fully connected layers are computationally intensive,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which is memory/time-consuming [3]. Each convolutional layer is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: comprised of convolution, batch normalization [42] and Rectified

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Linear Unit (ReLU) [43]. Here, the convolution is a process with a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: filter bank to produce a set of feature maps. The batch normaliza-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion is applied to reduce internal covariate shift. The ReLU layer

layout_dets.text: lutional layers, deep supervision is applied at each side-output layer and then all of them are concatenated to form a final fused output. In this way, the final output layer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acquires multi-scale and multi-level features as the plane size of the input of side-output layers becomes smaller and the receptive field size becomes larger. The fused

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prediction is refined by guided filtering with the first side-output layer.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computes the activation function max(0, x), which makes the net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: works able to learn a non-linear task. The spatial pooling is carried

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: out by four max-pooling layers, which follow some of the convo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lutional layers in each stage (not all the convolutional layers are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: followed by plane size reduction operation, respectively conv1_2,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: conv2_2, conv3_3 and conv4_3). The plane size reduction opera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion is achieved by a stride 2 block: a Max-pooling with 2 × 2 pixel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: filter. It is used to achieve translation invariance over small spa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tial shifts in the image, which can also reduce the parameter size

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the networks. The side-output features are obtained by a con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: volutional layer with a kernel size 1 and a number of output N.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Except the first side-output layer, other four side-output layers are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: followed by deconvolutional layers, which are applied to upsample

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the plane size of the feature maps to be the same as the input im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: age. Then, the upsampled feature maps are concatenated to form

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: final features, which are followed by a convolutional layer and a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: softmax layer. The output of the softmax layer is a N-channel map

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the probabilities where N is the number of classes (N = 2 in our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: application). According to the prediction of the softmax layer, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can get a predicted label for each pixel by a fixed threshold.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For a same input image, there is a fact that most predictions of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lower convolutional stages preserve well the crack region bound-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aries but are sensitive to local noise, such as dark spots and dirt.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: On the contrary, predictions of deeper convolutional stages show

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: better anti-noise abilities but fail in preserving the segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: boundaries. Therefore, it is a trade-off strategy to linearly fuse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the predictions of different convolutional stages. We explore fur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ther and first propose a novel method to refine the fused predic-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion by applying Guided Filtering [39], named as guided feathering.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: First, a binary mask is generated by the fused prediction. Then, the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: side-output of conv1_2 is set as a guidance map. The guided filter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieves the final refined prediction by well preserving the crack

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: regions and removing the noises in the low level prediction. Com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: paring to the CRF method, such technique is faster and more effi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cient.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our architecture consists of main three parts: (1) the convolu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tional layers which correspond to the first 13 convolutional layers

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the VGG-16 net [41]; (2) the side-output layers; (3) the refine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment module.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig. 2 shows the main architecture of our proposed model, in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which the details on each operations are presented. There are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: some differences with the VGG-16 networks: (1) we insert batch

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: normalization (BN) layer [42] between the convolutional layer and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ReLU layer [43], which is applied to improve model generalization;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (2) the pool5 layer and fully connected layers are discarded. Hence,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it is a fully convolutional network.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The side-output features are obtained by a convolutional layer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with a kernel size 1 and a number of output N (N=2). It can be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: treated as a linear fusion method and outputs a prediction map.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Given the differences of receptive field size, deeper predictions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are less affected by noises while lower ones present more de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tailed boundaries. The final fused result is a trade-off of these side-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: output predictions, as showed in Fig. 2.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We apply two methods to refine the fused prediction: Condi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tional Random Field (CRF) and Guided Filtering (GF) [39]. Here,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the CRF-based methods is similar to CRF-RNN [10]. Fig. 3 presents

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the guided filtering process, in which the predictions of fused and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eters are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for the guided filter.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our method has several advantages: (1) applying the whole im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: age to train and generate pixel-wise predictions in an end-to-end

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: manner, which is easy-to-use in practice; (2) the hierarchical fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture learning in a network, which has been proved beneficial in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: some computer tasks [11,33,44]; (3) refining the fused predictions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with an efficient guided filtering; (4) the computation efficiency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: due to discarding the fully connected layers (reducing the param-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eters of VGG-16 nets significantly from 134M to 14.7M).

layout_dets.text: 2.4. Data augmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Data augmentation has been proven to be a crucial technique in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: deep networks [3,4]. We rotated the images to 8 different angles

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (every 45° in [0°, 360°)) and cropped the largest rectangle in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rotated image (without the blank regions produced by rotation).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We also flipped the images at each angle horizontally. Hence, the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset were augmented by 16 times. In the training stage, we ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plied both the raw images and augmented ones to train networks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We resize the input images at 256 × 256 because of the rotation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transformation, which is different from the training without data

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: augmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: All models were trained and tested on a single NVIDIA TITAN

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: X. For a 544 × 384 input image, inference time is about 0.1 s. So,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: testing is efficient.

layout_dets.text: 4. Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Crack detection is a viable research. Unlike other detection

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks, segmenting the refined crack regions in pixel-wise is better

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: than predicting bounding-boxes in practice. Our work makes con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tributions to propose a CNN-based learning method for semantic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation and establish a challenging benchmark dataset with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-scene and multi-scale cracks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We present a deep hierarchical features learning architecture,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: named DeepCrack, for crack segmentation, which is inspired by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an edge detection network [3]. We keep the DSN module to pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vide integrated direct supervision for multi-level features learning,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: apply batch normalization [42] to reduce internal covariate shift,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and modify the cross-entropy loss function for our application, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attempt to refine the predictions, such as conditional random fields

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and guided filtering. The guided filtering method is faster and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more efficient than the conditional random fields. We established

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an open crack detection dataset to evaluate our method and com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pared with the up-to-date methods. Experimental results demon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strate that our method has achieved comparable performance with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the state-of-the-art methods.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the future, we will plan to exploit a better strategy to merge

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the features of side-output layers. More images of false crack re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gions will be added to the current benchmark database, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: will make the database more comprehensive. Some more detailed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: metrics, such as accuracies on specific scenes and scales, will be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposed.
